//: Kinds of signal (15 §3.1). Light off a body: it needs a line of sight and is scaled by the light where the body is. Nothing is seen inside a container.
doc: Light off a body: needs a line of sight, scaled by the light where the body is.

//: Sound passes walls with loss and is slower than a fast enough character. It leaves a container. Shares held back are by material, then by a tag of the material, then the default.
doc: Sound: passes obstacles with loss by their materials, falls off with the square of the distance, and arrives after distance over the speed of sound.
